replication.target_description: Comparison of movement initiation times for food versus non-food objects in the grasp condition. Grasp movement onset is identified, but the description does not specify high- versus low-calorie food or the non-food control (balls versus office tools). The source gives only pooled bounds across several Wilcoxon comparisons. No unique test statistic can be assigned.
